infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Lidcombe and Strathfield. Trains to the City do not stop at Croydon or Ashfield
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 22 and Sunday 23 November 
  • Buses replace trains between Lidcombe and Strathfield.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Leppington and Olympic Park via Granville and between Leppington and Lidcombe via Regents Park.
  • Change at Lidcombe for buses towards Strathfield. Replacement buses do not leave from Olympic Park.
  • You can also change at Glenfield for trains to the City via the Airport.

  • Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern between Strathfield and T1 North Shore Line stations. You may need to change services to continue your journey.
  • Trains to the City do not stop at Croydon or Ashfield. Buses run from Strathfield to Ashfield, stopping at all stations, in that direction only.
  • Trains from the City stop at Ashfield and Croydon.
  • Inner West trains run between Ashfield and the City Circle only.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes

67T1 Lidcombe, all stations to Strathfield and return
68T1 Lidcombe, express to Strathfield and return
43T2 Strathfield, all stations to Ashfield (in that direction only)

Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless payment. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern due to City Circle trackwork
infoLinks.content:
Monday 1 and Tuesday 2 December   
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, trains via the Airport start and end at Central due to City Circle trackwork.
  • T8 trains do not run between Sydenham and the City. T4 trains run between Sydenham and Bondi Junction, making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
Train and light rail trackwork in the City may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run on the City Circle, or between Central and Wynyard. L2 and L3 light rail services do not run between Circular Quay and Juniors Kingsford or Randwick.
  • Buses replace City Circle trains and light rail services in one direction only. From Central, buses stop Museum, St James, Circular Quay, Wynyard, Town Hall and Central.

  • For travel in the City use metro services between Central, Martin Place and Gadigal (Town Hall), or use replacement buses to other City stations.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
10CC Central, Museum, St James, Circular Quay, Wynyard, Town Hall, Central (loop service)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Balmain diversions for Festival of Balmain
infoLinks.content:

  • From 1.30am to 11pm, route 445 buses will divert around sections of Darling Street, Short Street, Ford Street and Little Darling Street and miss stops due to road closures for the Festival of Balmain event.
  • The local council has organised Shuttle Bus services to run on Darling Street between Victoria Rd and Balmain East Wharf.
  • Buses towards Campsie commence from Darling Street before Belmore Street (203939).
  • Services travelling towards Gladstone Park will terminate at Darling Street before Waterloo Street (203941). Please catch the council shuttle bus at Rozelle Public School on Darling Street (203928).

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Macquarie Fields
infoLinks.content:
Station Access Changes
From Tuesday 26 August 2025 until mid-2026, the pedestrian ramp access from Railway Parade into the station on Platform 2 will be closed for upgrade works.
During this time, station access will be available via the stairs only.
Planned Trackwork buses depart from Atchinson Rd near the Service Station.
If you require ramp or lift access, please visit transportnsw.info for your accessible travel options.
For more information about the project, please contact the Project Infoline on 1800 684 490 or visit www.transport.nsw.gov.au/macquariefields.

urlText: Station Update - Macquarie Fields
content:
Station Access Changes
From Tuesday 26 August 2025 until mid-2026, the pedestrian ramp access from Railway Parade into the station on Platform 2 will be closed for upgrade works.
During this time, station access will be available via the stairs only.
Planned Trackwork buses depart from Atchinson Rd near the Service Station.
If you require ramp or lift access, please visit transportnsw.info for your accessible travel options.
For more information about the project, please contact the Project Infoline on 1800 684 490 or visit www.transport.nsw.gov.au/macquariefields.
subtitle: Station Update - Macquarie Fields

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Sydenham and Central. Trackwork on the T4 and South Coast lines may affect how you travel
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 29 and Sunday 30 November  
  • Buses replace trains between Sydenham and Central.
  • Metro services run between Sydenham and Tallawong.
  • Trains run to the normal timetable between Macarthur, Revesby and the City via the Airport.
  • Trackwork on the T4 Illawarra and South Coast lines may also affect how you travel.
  • From Airport stations, change at:
    • Central for trains towards Bondi Junction, or buses to Illawarra and South Coast Line stations
    • Wolli Creek for all-stations buses to T4 Illawarra Line stations. If you have luggage or accessibility needs change at Central.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
1T3 Sydenham, St Peters, Erskineville, Redfern, Central and return
7AT4 Hurstville, all stations to Sydenham, Redfern and return
13T4 Kogarah, Rockdale, express to Wolli Creek and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

  • Change at Epping or Central for metro services to North Shore and City stations or use replacement buses to other City stations from Central.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:

  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trackwork buses do not leave from Martin Place Station, use metro services.
  • Most trains run to a changed timetable between Waterfall or Cronulla and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Change at:
    • Sydenham or Central for metro services to Martin Place
    • Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    • Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction

  • Nightly from 10.10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.urlText: Trains run between Blue Mountains Line stations and Blacktown. Buses replace trains between Lidcombe and Strathfield
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 22 and Sunday 23 November
  • Trains run between Blue Mountains Line stations and Blacktown only.
  • Change at Penrith for express buses to Strathfield.
  • T1 Western Line trains run between Penrith, Blacktown and Olympic Park. Buses replace trains between Lidcombe and Strathfield.
  • Trains from Blacktown run to Blue Mountains Line stations run 30 minutes later than normal.

  • Most Bathurst trains run between Bathurst and Lithgow only, some to a changed timetable. Change trains at Lithgow to continue your journey.

infoLinks.content:
Monday 1 to Thursday 4 December 
  • Nightly from 9.40pm to 2.30am, buses replace trains between Cronulla and Sutherland.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Waterfall, Sutherland and Bondi Junction.
  • Monday and Tuesday, some trains make extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.

  • Friday from 12.20am to 2.30am, buses replace trains between Cronulla and Hurstville. Buses also replace trains from Hurstville to Waterfall, in that direction only.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.urlText: Balmain diversions for Festival of Balmain
infoLinks.content:
Sunday 30 November
  • From 1.30am to 11pm, route 430 buses will divert around sections of Darling Street, Short Street, Ford Street and Little Darling Street and miss stops due to road closures for the Festival of Balmain event.
  • The local council has organised Shuttle Bus services to run on Darling Street between Victoria Rd and Balmain East Wharf.
  • Buses towards Central commence from Darling Street opposite Rozelle Public School (203938).
  • Services travelling towards Gladstone Park will terminate at Victoria Road before Darling Street (203923). Please catch the council shuttle bus at Rozelle Public School on Darling Street instead (203928).
  • Check signs at stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.

urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, and some trains between Waterfall and Sutherland
content:
Saturday 6 and Sunday 7 December  
  • Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Cronulla, Waterfall and North Sydney, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Metro services do not run between Sydenham and Chatswood.
  • Change at:
    • Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    • Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction
  • Trackwork buses do not leave from Martin Place Station.

    • Saturday from 4.30am to 11.30am, buses replace trains between Waterfall and Sutherland.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Cronulla, Sutherland and North Sydney.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
10T4 Waterfall, all stations to Sutherland and return (Saturday morning only)
20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4 Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
subtitle: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, and some trains between Waterfall and Sutherland

infoLinks.urlText: Surry Hills bus diversions for Christmas Fair
infoLinks.content:
From 7am until 11:30pm on Saturday 13 December, route 304 services will be diverting around Crown St and missing stops between Albion St and Cleveland St while road closures are in place for the City of Sydney’s Surry Hills Christmas Fair.
 
Services towards Bondi Junction will be diverting via Cleveland St, South Dowling St, Fitzroy St and Foveaux St.
 
Services towards Marrickville will be diverting via Albion St, Flinders St, South Dowling St and Cleveland St.
 
Use alternative stops further along Crown St or Baptist St. Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. 
 
Missed stops:
  • Crown St at Miles St (Stop ID 201021)

  • Crown St before Foveaux St (stop ID 201023)
  • Crown St opp Lansdowne St (stop ID 201098)
  • Crown St at Rainford St (stop ID 201092)

infoLinks.urlText: T1 Western Line: Trains run between Penrith and Central, platforms 1-14 only, due to City Circle trackwork
infoLinks.content:
Monday 1 and Tuesday 2 December 
  • Nightly from 10pm to 1.30am, trains run to a changed timetable between Penrith and Central, platforms 1-14 only, due to City Circle trackwork.
  • Trains make extra stops at some stations between Parramatta and Burwood.
Train and light rail trackwork in the City may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run on the City Circle, or between Central and Wynyard. L2 and L3 light rail services do not run between Circular Quay and Juniors Kingsford or Randwick.
  • Buses replace City Circle trains and light rail services in one direction only. From Central, buses stop Museum, St James, Circular Quay, Wynyard, Town Hall and Central.

  • Use metro services to travel between Central, Martin Place, Gadigal (Town Hall) and T1 North Shore Line stations, or use replacement buses to other City stations.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
10CC Central, Museum, St James, Circular Quay, Wynyard, Town Hall, Central and return

  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run due to trackwork and maintenance works
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 24 November, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run due to trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time, use alternative transport including L4 replacement bus services, trains, regular bus services or walking if able to, between Westmead and Carlingford.
 
L4 replacement bus services:
  • Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 8pm to 1am daily. These times may vary depending on road traffic.
  • Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
    • Westmead Hospital– Please use the alternative stop at Westmead Station (approx. 6 minute walk)
    • Ngara– Please use the alternative stop at Benaud Oval (approx. 5 minute walk)
    • Rosehill Gardens – Please use the alternative stop at Tramway Avenue (approx. 10 minute walk)
  • Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
See the news story for more detailed service information.
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.

From Monday 1 December, changes to route 893 services will be as follows:
  • The 14:53 service from Narellan on weekdays will now depart 3 minutes earlier at 14:50. Departure times at stops throughout the journey will also change.
  • The 14:53 service from Narellan on weekdays will now operate via Spring Farm Dr and Norfolk Ave in Spring Farm, providing better travel options for students at Spring Farm Public School.
subtitle: Changes to route 893 weekday service

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Dapto, Port Kembla and Sutherland
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 6 December 
  • From 3am to 11am, buses replace trains between Dapto, Port Kembla and Sutherland.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Bomaderry, Kiama and Dapto, and T4 Illawarra trains run between Sutherland and North Sydney.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
14SC Dapto, all stations to Thirroul and return
27SC Port Kembla, all stations to Wollongong and return
29SC Helensburgh Station, Helensburgh Town Centre (Charles Harper Park), Otford and return
64SC Thirroul, all stations to Stanwell Park, then Helensburgh Town Centre (Charles Harper Park), Waterfall, all stations to Sutherland and return
71SC Thirroul, Sutherland and return
72SC Dapto, Wollongong, North Wollongong, Sutherland and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
